SELECT 'STG_EDS_LNS_ACCTPARTITION', COUNT(*), CONVERT(DATE,LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8)) AS_OF_DATE FROM D360.STG_EDS_LNS_ACCTPARTITION WHERE H='D' GROUP BY CONVERT(DATE,LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8))
UNION ALL
SELECT 'LNS_ACCTPARTITION',COUNT(*),AS_OF_DATE FROM EDS.LNS_ACCTPARTITION GROUP BY AS_OF_DATE

SELECT  * FROM EDS.LNS_ACCTPARTITION

SELECT  
SYSTEM_CLASSIFICATION_DATE
,USER_CLASSIFICATION_DATE
,LCHG_TIME
,RCRE_TIME FROM  EDS.LNS_ASSTCLASSDETAIL


SELECT  
LINK_DATE
,RCRE_TIME
,UNLINK_DATE
,LCHG_TIME FROM D360.STG_EDS_LNS_CUSTSBLIMITLINK
